component.name: Nextcloud Native
component.summary: One native client for your complete Nextcloud account

description.p: Nextcloud Native brings files, photos, media, collaboration, and installed Nextcloud apps together in one coherent native desktop client.
It uses native controls and verified server capabilities instead of embedding the web interface. Account data stays between this app and the Nextcloud servers you choose.

ul.li: Browse files, photos, media, activity, and collaboration apps.
Keep selected content available offline and review transfer state.
Adapt installed Nextcloud apps to reusable native workflows.

screenshot.caption: A native desktop workspace for a complete Nextcloud account
Visible file transfer and synchronization progress

description.p: First signed testing release of the native Android and desktop clients.
